name: Saint Lucia
summary_text: Saint Lucia demands real caution. The Eastern Caribbean Supreme Court struck down sodomy/gross-indecency laws in July 2025 (Randall Theodule v AG) — the region's most recent decriminalisation, welcomed by the IACHR. Saint Lucia has a relatively organised community (ECADE, United and Strong) and hosts Pride. No LGR.

sources.title: Saint Lucia High Court Decriminalizes Same-Sex Conduct | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch (Jul 2025): 'Saint Lucia High Court Decriminalizes Same-Sex Conduct' — the court rules the 'gross indecency' and 'unnatural offences' provisions violate constitutional protections.

NOTE: Not retrievable at research time (HTTP 403); the underlying Human Dignity Trust case digest covers Randall Theodule et al. v. the Attorney General of Saint Lucia - the constitutional challenge that decriminalised same-sex conduct.

sources.title: Don't ignore us, Caribbean activists tell UK gay press
sources.claim_summary: Erasing 76 Crimes (April 2017): Caribbean activists (United and Strong of St Lucia, ECADE) protested PinkNews's framing of a Stonewall charity auction of a St Lucia holiday - 'Nothing about us without us'; St Lucia's law carries up to 10 years for gay sex.
AP News: St Lucia court ruling that criminalising gay sex is unconstitutional - the Eastern Caribbean litigation striking down the colonial-era law (page largely navigation content at fetch time).
Pride Source (Michigan LGBTQ paper): article referencing St Lucia (page largely navigation content at fetch time).

sources.title: Rights Sensitisation for Law Enforcement Officers | United and Strong (LGBTQI) St Lucia
sources.claim_summary: United and Strong St Lucia (May 2015): human-rights sensitisation training for law enforcement - extending 2014 RSLPF training to Air/Sea Ports, Customs and Corrections officers, facilitated by Maurice Tomlinson; part of advocacy to reduce discrimination and achieve equality.
